final: WITH st AS (SELECT c.state_county_province AS state, SUM(t.transaction_amount) AS total FROM Financial_Transactions t JOIN Accounts a ON a.account_id = t.account_id JOIN Customers c ON c.customer_id = a.customer_id GROUP BY c.state_county_province), ov AS (SELECT SUM(total) AS overall FROM st), sh AS (SELECT st.state, st.total, st.total * 1.0 / ov.overall AS share FROM st, ov), av AS (SELECT AVG(share) AS avg_share FROM sh), kept AS (SELECT sh.total, sh.share, av.avg_share FROM sh, av WHERE sh.share > av.avg_share) SELECT SUM(total) AS total_kept, AVG(share) AS avg_share_kept, AVG(share - avg_share) AS avg_excess FROM kept
